rule_name: Talking Heads, Anchor Dialogue in Physical Space
quote: Does it work with negative numbers?
why: opens a four-line exchange (through "Then it works.") with zero physical anchoring or attribution, leaving the reader without a room or a speaker
suggestion: A hand goes up near the back. "Does it work with negative numbers?"
